purpose: Recovery proof before applying existing migration0040; this helper applies no migration
source_mutations: none: read-only SQL, exported snapshot and pg_dump only
backup_location: protected external checkpoint directory; never inside repository
encryption: AES-256-CBC / PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256,250000 iterations; independent domain-separated HMAC-SHA256 ciphertext authentication
restore_isolation: immutable hardened restore image with identical postgres/pg_dump/pg_restore SHA256; unique control user; network none; tmpfs; no ports
restore_binary_comparison: postgres, pg_dump and pg_restore SHA256 match source; source image no longer available locally
schema_comparison: Only pg_dump guards and constant varchar-array/text casts normalized; Boolean grouping/operators and all other DDL preserved. Built-in pg_* membership initdb grantor names canonicalized; application grantors unchanged.
